entry.title: New: Bill 29 (2025) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 2.88.030, MAUI COUNTY CODE, ON THE MAUI COUNTY CULTURAL RESOURCES COMMISSION'S MEMBERSHIP" The purpose of this bill is to remove the requirement for the Maui County Cultural Resources Commission to have at least one representative from each island.

View on the council site
